type_of_casing.description: Item 36 Casing Record > 'Type of Casing' column — one of conductor, surface, intermediate, conventional production, tapered production, or other, as written for this casing string. This is the row identity_key. Transcribe the typed/handwritten cell value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, fractions and any printed unit); null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with the item-37 Liner Record (a separate table) or with the item-38 Tubing size.
type_of_casing.title: Type Of Casing Conductor Surface Intermediate Conventional Production Tapered Production Or Other

casing_size.description: Item 36 Casing Record > 'Casing Size (in.)' column — the outer diameter of this casing string in inches. Transcribe the typed/handwritten cell value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, fractions and any printed unit); null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with 'Hole Size (in.)' (the drilled-hole diameter) in the adjacent column, or with the item-37 Liner Size or item-38 Tubing Size.
casing_size.title: Casing Size In

weight_per_ft.description: Item 36 Casing Record > 'WT #/FT' column — the casing weight per foot for this string, printed between 'CASING SIZE' and 'DEPTH SET' on the old-rev layout. Transcribe the typed/handwritten cell value verbatim as printed (preserve any '#' unit marker); null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with 'Casing Size' (the pipe outer diameter) in the preceding column.
weight_per_ft.title: WT Per FT

hole_size.description: Item 36 Casing Record > 'Hole Size (in.)' column — the drilled-hole diameter for this casing string, in inches. Transcribe the typed/handwritten cell value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, fractions and any printed unit); null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with 'Casing Size (in.)' (the pipe OD) in the adjacent column.
hole_size.title: Hole Size In

setting_depth.description: Item 36 Casing Record > 'Setting Depth (ft.)' column — the depth to which this casing string was set, in feet. Transcribe the typed/handwritten cell value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, fractions and any printed unit); null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with 'Multi-Stage Tool Depth' or 'Multi-Stage Shoe Depth' in the same row, or with 'Top of Cement'.
setting_depth.title: Setting Depth Ft

multistage_tool_depth.description: Item 36 Casing Record > 'Multi-Stage Tool Depth (ft.)' column. Transcribe the typed/handwritten cell value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, fractions and any printed unit); null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with 'Multi-Stage Shoe Depth (ft.)' (the very next column) or with 'Setting Depth (ft.)'.
multistage_tool_depth.title: Multi Stage Tool Depth Ft

multistage_shoe_depth.description: Item 36 Casing Record > 'Multi-Stage Shoe Depth (ft.)' column. Transcribe the typed/handwritten cell value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, fractions and any printed unit); null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with 'Multi-Stage Tool Depth (ft.)' (the immediately preceding column) or with 'Setting Depth (ft.)'.
multistage_shoe_depth.title: Multi Stage Shoe Depth Ft

cement_class.description: Item 36 Casing Record > 'Cement Class' column — the API cement class used (e.g. 'A', 'H', 'C'). Transcribe the typed/handwritten cell value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, fractions and any printed unit); null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with 'Cement Amount (sacks)' or 'Slurry Volume (cu. ft.)' in the same row, nor with the item-37 Liner cement columns.
cement_class.title: Cement Class

cement_amount.description: Item 36 Casing Record > 'Cement Amount (sacks)' column — the number of sacks of cement pumped. Transcribe the typed/handwritten cell value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, fractions and any printed unit); null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with 'Slurry Volume (cu. ft.)' (a volume, not a sack count) or 'Cement Class'.
cement_amount.title: Cement Amount Sacks

slurry_volume.description: Item 36 Casing Record > 'Slurry Volume (cu. ft.)' column — the cement slurry volume in cubic feet. Transcribe the typed/handwritten cell value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, fractions and any printed unit); null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with 'Cement Amount (sacks)' (a sack count) in the adjacent column.
slurry_volume.title: Slurry Volume Cu Ft

top_of_cement.description: Item 36 Casing Record > 'Top of Cement' column — the depth/position of the top of the cement column behind this casing. Transcribe the typed/handwritten cell value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, fractions and any printed unit); null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with 'Top of Cement Determined By' (the method column immediately after) or with 'Setting Depth'.
top_of_cement.title: Top Of Cement

top_of_cement_determined_by.description: Item 36 Casing Record > 'Top of Cement Determined By' column — the method used to determine the top of cement (e.g. calculation, temperature/CBL log). Transcribe the typed/handwritten cell value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, fractions and any printed unit); null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with the 'Top of Cement' depth value in the preceding column.
top_of_cement_determined_by.title: Top Of Cement Determined By

liner_size.description: Item 37 Liner Record > 'Liner Size (in.)' column — the liner outer diameter in inches. This is the row identity_key. Transcribe the typed/handwritten cell value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, fractions and any printed unit); null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with the item-36 Casing Size (a separate table) or with 'Hole Size (in.)' in this same row.
liner_size.title: Liner Size In

hole_size.description: Item 37 Liner Record > 'Hole Size (in.)' column — the drilled-hole diameter for the liner, in inches. Transcribe the typed/handwritten cell value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, fractions and any printed unit); null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with 'Liner Size (in.)' (the pipe OD) in the adjacent column.
hole_size.title: Hole Size In

liner_top.description: Item 37 Liner Record > 'Liner Top (ft.)' column — the depth of the top of the liner, in feet. Transcribe the typed/handwritten cell value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, fractions and any printed unit); null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with 'Liner Bottom (ft.)' (the very next column) or with 'Top of Cement'.
liner_top.title: Liner Top Ft

liner_bottom.description: Item 37 Liner Record > 'Liner Bottom (ft.)' column — the depth of the bottom of the liner, in feet. Transcribe the typed/handwritten cell value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, fractions and any printed unit); null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with 'Liner Top (ft.)' (the immediately preceding column).
liner_bottom.title: Liner Bottom Ft

cement_class.description: Item 37 Liner Record > 'Cement Class' column. Transcribe the typed/handwritten cell value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, fractions and any printed unit); null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with the item-36 Casing Record cement columns (a separate table) or with 'Cement Amount (sacks)' / 'Slurry Volume (cu. ft.)' in this row.
cement_class.title: Cement Class

cement_amount.description: Item 37 Liner Record > 'Cement Amount (sacks)' column. Transcribe the typed/handwritten cell value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, fractions and any printed unit); null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with 'Slurry Volume (cu. ft.)' (a volume) or 'Cement Class'.
cement_amount.title: Cement Amount Sacks

slurry_volume.description: Item 37 Liner Record > 'Slurry Volume (cu. ft.)' column. Transcribe the typed/handwritten cell value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, fractions and any printed unit); null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with 'Cement Amount (sacks)' (a sack count).
slurry_volume.title: Slurry Volume Cu Ft

top_of_cement.description: Item 37 Liner Record > 'Top of Cement' column. Transcribe the typed/handwritten cell value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, fractions and any printed unit); null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with 'Top of Cement Determined By' (the method column after it) or with 'Liner Top (ft.)'.
top_of_cement.title: Top Of Cement

top_of_cement_determined_by.description: Item 37 Liner Record > 'Top of Cement Determined By' column — the method used to determine the top of cement. Transcribe the typed/handwritten cell value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, fractions and any printed unit); null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with the 'Top of Cement' depth value in the preceding column.
top_of_cement_determined_by.title: Top Of Cement Determined By

size.description: Item 38 Tubing Record > 'Size (in.)' column — the tubing outer diameter in inches for this tubing string. This is the row identity_key. Transcribe the typed/handwritten cell value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, fractions and any printed unit); null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with the item-36 Casing Size or item-37 Liner Size (separate tables), nor with 'Depth Set (ft.)' in this row. The tubing YES/NO and SWR-13 boxes above the grid are separate scalar fields (tubing_set_yes/tubing_set_no/tubing_swr13_exception).
size.title: Size In

depth_set.description: Item 38 Tubing Record > 'Depth Set (ft.)' column — the depth to which this tubing string was set, in feet. Transcribe the typed/handwritten cell value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, fractions and any printed unit); null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with 'Packer Depth/Type' (the next column) or with the casing/liner setting depths in items 36-37.
depth_set.title: Depth Set Ft

packer_depth_type.description: Item 38 Tubing Record > 'Packer Depth/Type' column — the packer depth and/or packer type for this tubing string. Transcribe the typed/handwritten cell value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, fractions and any printed unit); null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with 'Depth Set (ft.)' (the tubing setting depth) in the preceding column.
packer_depth_type.title: Packer Depth Type

from_depth.description: Item 39 'Producing/Injection/Disposal Interval' table ('Indicate top and bottom measured depths of completion interval(s) or open hole') > the 'From' (top) measured depth of this interval. This is the row identity_key. Transcribe the typed/handwritten cell value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, fractions and any printed unit); null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with the paired 'To' (bottom) depth (to_depth) of the same interval, nor with the separate operations 'Depth Interval' table near item 45 (operation_depth_intervals).
from_depth.title: From

to_depth.description: Item 39 'Producing/Injection/Disposal Interval' table > the 'To' (bottom) measured depth of this interval. Transcribe the typed/handwritten cell value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, fractions and any printed unit); null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with the paired 'From' (top) depth (from_depth) or with the operations 'Depth Interval' table (operation_depth_intervals).
to_depth.title: To

from_depth.description: The operations table (between items 44 and 45) > 'Depth Interval (ft.)' > the 'From' (top) depth of the interval treated by the corresponding operation (acid/fracture/cement squeeze/etc.). This is the row identity_key. Transcribe the typed/handwritten cell value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, fractions and any printed unit); null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with the item-39 'Producing/Injection/Disposal Interval' From/To table (producing_injection_disposal_intervals) — this Depth Interval belongs to the Type-of-Operation table — nor with the paired 'To' depth (to_depth).
from_depth.title: From

to_depth.description: The operations table (between items 44 and 45) > 'Depth Interval (ft.)' > the 'To' (bottom) depth of the treated interval. Transcribe the typed/handwritten cell value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, fractions and any printed unit); null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with the paired 'From' depth (from_depth) or with the item-39 interval table (producing_injection_disposal_intervals).
to_depth.title: To

markers_formation_tops.description: Item 45 Formation Record > 'Principal Geological Markers and Formation Tops' column — the name of the geological marker / formation top for this row (the table lists 'depths of principal geological markers and formation tops, including ... all permitted disposal/injection formations within 1/4-mile of the wellbore, productive zones, potential flow zones, and corrosive formation fluid zones'). This is the row identity_key. Transcribe the typed/handwritten cell value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, fractions and any printed unit); null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with the depth columns (depth_tvd/depth_md) or the 'Indicate if formation is...' classification column (formation_type).
markers_formation_tops.title: Principal Geological Markers And Formation Tops

depth_tvd.description: Item 45 Formation Record > 'Depth (ft.)' > TVD sub-column — the true vertical depth of this formation top. Transcribe the typed/handwritten cell value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, fractions and any printed unit); null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with the paired MD depth (depth_md) or with the item-31 Total Depth TVD.
depth_tvd.title: Depth Ft TVD

depth_md.description: Item 45 Formation Record > 'Depth (ft.)' > MD sub-column — the measured depth of this formation top. Transcribe the typed/handwritten cell value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, fractions and any printed unit); null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with the paired TVD depth (depth_tvd) or with the item-31 Total Depth MD.
depth_md.title: Depth Ft MD

formation_type.description: Item 45 Formation Record > 'Indicate if formation is a permitted disposal/injection formation, productive zone, potential flow zone, and/or a zone with corrosive formation fluids' column — the free-text classification of this formation. Transcribe the typed/handwritten cell value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, fractions and any printed unit); null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with the 'Is formation isolated in this well?' YES/NO column (formation_isolated) or the marker name (markers_formation_tops).
formation_type.title: Indicate If Formation Is A Permitted Disposal Injection Formation Productive Zone Potential Flow Zone And Or A Zone With Corrosive Formation Fluids

formation_isolated.description: Item 45 Formation Record > 'Is formation isolated in this well? (YES/NO) (if NO, explain in remarks)' column — the YES/NO answer for this formation, captured as the printed text (e.g. 'YES'/'NO'). Transcribe the typed/handwritten cell value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, fractions and any printed unit); null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with the 'Indicate if formation is...' classification column (formation_type).
formation_isolated.title: Is Formation Isolated In This Well YES NO If NO Explain In Remarks

field_reservoir.description: Item 39 'If multiple completion, list all reservoir names...' table (old-rev layout; page 2) — the 'FIELD & RESERVOIR' column for this row: one of the reservoirs this multiple-completion well produces from. This is the row identity_key. Transcribe verbatim; null if blank. Only present when item 38 'Is well multiple completion?' = Yes and the form prints a genuine multi-row table (distinct from the single-value `item13_field_reservoir` used by the modern form's former-reservoir citation).
field_reservoir.title: Field Reservoir

gas_id_or_oil_lease_no.description: Item 39 table 'GAS ID or OIL LEASE #' column for this reservoir row. Transcribe verbatim; null if blank or not legible.
gas_id_or_oil_lease_no.title: Gas ID Or Oil Lease No

oil_or_gas.description: Item 39 table 'Oil-O Gas-G' column for this reservoir row. Transcribe verbatim; null if blank or not legible.
oil_or_gas.title: Oil O Gas G

well_no.description: Item 39 table 'WELL #' column for this reservoir row. Transcribe verbatim; null if blank or not legible.
well_no.title: Well No

api_no.description: Page 1 header (top-right): the well's API number, printed after the fixed 'API No.: 42-' prefix (Texas state code 42). Capture the digits the operator enters after '42-' (county + unique-well portion); include the '42-' prefix if it is written into the value. Transcribe the typed/handwritten value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, punctuation and any printed unit); null if the box is blank. Do NOT confuse with 'api_no_page2' (the same number repeated in the page-2 header), with RRC District No. (item 7), RRC Lease No. (item 8) or RRC Operator No.
api_no.title: API No 42

rrc_district_no.description: Item 7 (upper-right block): RRC District No. — the Railroad Commission administrative district for the well (a 1-2 character district code, e.g. '7B', '08', '01'). Transcribe the typed/handwritten value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, punctuation and any printed unit); null if the box is blank. Do NOT confuse with RRC Lease No. (item 8), RRC Operator No., or County (item 10).
rrc_district_no.title: RRC District No

rrc_lease_no.description: Item 8 (upper-right block): RRC Lease No. — the Commission-assigned lease identification number for this lease/reservoir. Transcribe the typed/handwritten value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, punctuation and any printed unit); null if the box is blank. Do NOT confuse with RRC District No. (item 7), Well No. (item 9), RRC Operator No., or the item-13 'Gas ID or Oil Lease No.' of the former reservoir.
rrc_lease_no.title: RRC Lease No

field_name.description: Item 1: Field Name (as per RRC Records or Wildcat) — the RRC field name the well produces from, or the word 'Wildcat'. Transcribe the typed/handwritten value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, punctuation and any printed unit); null if the box is blank. Do NOT confuse with Lease Name (item 2) or with the former Field & Reservoir of item 13.
field_name.title: Field Name As Per RRC Records Or Wildcat

lease_name.description: Item 2: Lease Name — the operator's name for the lease on which the well sits. Transcribe the typed/handwritten value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, punctuation and any printed unit); null if the box is blank. Do NOT confuse with Field Name (item 1), Operator's Name (item 3), or Well No. (item 9).
lease_name.title: Lease Name

well_no.description: Item 9 (upper-right block): Well No. — the operator's well number/designation on this lease (e.g. '1', '3H', '2-A'). Transcribe the typed/handwritten value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, punctuation and any printed unit); null if the box is blank. Do NOT confuse with the former-completion Well No. in item 13 (item13_well_no), RRC Lease No. (item 8), or RRC District No. (item 7).
well_no.title: Well No

operator_name.description: Item 3: Operator's Name, printed 'exactly as shown on Form P-5, Organization Report'. The legal name of the operating company filing the report. Transcribe the typed/handwritten value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, punctuation and any printed unit); null if the box is blank. Do NOT confuse with RRC Operator No. (the adjacent numeric operator code), Lease Name (item 2), or the broker/certifier Printed Name in the certification block.
operator_name.title: Operator S Name Exactly As Shown On Form P 5 Organization Report

rrc_operator_no.description: RRC Operator No. (small box adjacent to item 3 Operator's Name): the Commission-assigned P-5 operator number (6-digit numeric code). Transcribe the typed/handwritten value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, punctuation and any printed unit); null if the box is blank. Do NOT confuse with RRC Lease No. (item 8), RRC District No. (item 7), or the operator's name itself (item 3).
rrc_operator_no.title: RRC Operator No

county.description: Item 10: County — the Texas county in which the well is located. Transcribe the typed/handwritten value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, punctuation and any printed unit); null if the box is blank. Do NOT confuse with RRC District No. (item 7) or with the 'nearest town in the county' free-text in item 5b (well_located_nearest_town).
county.title: County

operator_address.description: Item 4: Operator's Address (include street, city, state, zip code) — the full mailing address of the operator as one block. Transcribe the typed/handwritten value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, punctuation and any printed unit); null if the box is blank. Do NOT confuse with Operator's Name (item 3) or with the certifier's contact info in the certification block.
operator_address.title: Operator S Address Include Street City State Zip Code

purpose_of_filing.description: Item 11: Purpose of filing — a free-text purpose statement (note that the structured A/B option boxes for Producers and Injection/Disposal sit beneath this label). Transcribe the typed/handwritten value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, punctuation and any printed unit); null if the box is blank. Do NOT confuse with the boolean option boxes under 'A. Producers' (producers_*) or 'B. Injection/Disposal/Storage/Brine Mining' (injdisp_*).
purpose_of_filing.title: Purpose Of Filing

producers_initial_potential.description: Item 11 > 'A. Producers' option group: the 'Initial potential' checkbox. Boolean: true only if this specific box is marked/checked on the scan, false if left blank. Do NOT confuse with the other Producers boxes (Retest, Reclass, Well record only) or with the Injection/Disposal 'Initial completion' box (injdisp_*).
producers_initial_potential.title: Initial Potential

producers_retest.description: Item 11 > 'A. Producers' option group: the 'Retest' checkbox. Boolean: true only if this specific box is marked/checked on the scan, false if left blank. Do NOT confuse with 'Initial potential', 'Reclass', or 'Well record only' in the same Producers group, nor with the swab-test YES/NO in item 21.
producers_retest.title: Retest

producers_reclass.description: Item 11 > 'A. Producers' option group: the 'Reclass' checkbox. Boolean: true only if this specific box is marked/checked on the scan, false if left blank. Do NOT confuse with the Injection/Disposal 'Reclass' box (injdisp_reclass) — this one belongs to the Producers (A) group — nor with 'Recompletion or reclass' in item 13.
producers_reclass.title: Reclass

producers_well_record_only.description: Item 11 > 'A. Producers' option group: the 'Well record only (explain in remarks)' checkbox. Boolean: true only if this specific box is marked/checked on the scan, false if left blank. Do NOT confuse with the Injection/Disposal 'Well record only' box (injdisp_well_record_only) in group B.
producers_well_record_only.title: Well Record Only Explain In Remarks

location_section_block_survey.description: Item 5a: Location (section, block and survey) — the abstract/survey description of the surface location. Transcribe the typed/handwritten value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, punctuation and any printed unit); null if the box is blank. Do NOT confuse with item 5b's distance/direction/nearest-town narrative or with the Latitude/Longitude in item 6.
location_section_block_survey.title: 5a Location Section Block And Survey

well_located_miles.description: Item 5b narrative ('This well is located ____ miles in a ____ direction from ____, which is the nearest town in the county'): the MILES value in the first blank. Transcribe the typed/handwritten value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, punctuation and any printed unit); null if the box is blank. Do NOT confuse with well_located_direction (the compass direction blank) or well_located_nearest_town (the town blank) in the same sentence.
well_located_miles.title: Miles

well_located_direction.description: Item 5b narrative: the DIRECTION value in the second blank ('in a ____ direction from'), e.g. a compass bearing like 'NW' or 'South'. Transcribe the typed/handwritten value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, punctuation and any printed unit); null if the box is blank. Do NOT confuse with well_located_miles (the distance blank) or well_located_nearest_town (the town blank).
well_located_direction.title: Direction From

well_located_nearest_town.description: Item 5b narrative: the NEAREST TOWN value in the third blank ('from ____, which is the nearest town in the county'). Transcribe the typed/handwritten value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, punctuation and any printed unit); null if the box is blank. Do NOT confuse with County (item 10), well_located_miles, or well_located_direction.
well_located_nearest_town.title: Nearest Town In The County

well_latitude_longitude.description: Item 6: Well Latitude/Longitude (minimum five decimal places required) — the surface-location coordinates as printed. Transcribe the typed/handwritten value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, punctuation and any printed unit); null if the box is blank. Do NOT confuse with the adjacent 'Latitude/Longitude type' field (latitude_longitude_type) or with the Location section/block/survey (item 5a).
well_latitude_longitude.title: Well Latitude Longitude Minimum Five Decimal Places Required

latitude_longitude_type.description: The 'Latitude/Longitude type:' field directly beneath item 6 — the datum/method descriptor for the coordinates (e.g. surface, bottom-hole, NAD27/NAD83). Transcribe the typed/handwritten value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, punctuation and any printed unit); null if the box is blank. Do NOT confuse with the coordinate values themselves (well_latitude_longitude).
latitude_longitude_type.title: Latitude Longitude Type

injdisp_initial_completion.description: Item 11 > 'B. Injection/Disposal/Storage/Brine Mining' option group: the 'Initial completion' checkbox. Boolean: true only if this specific box is marked/checked on the scan, false if left blank. Do NOT confuse with the Producers (A) 'Initial potential' box (producers_initial_potential) or with item 23 'New well'.
injdisp_initial_completion.title: Initial Completion

injdisp_reclass.description: Item 11 > 'B. Injection/Disposal/Storage/Brine Mining' option group: the 'Reclass' checkbox. Boolean: true only if this specific box is marked/checked on the scan, false if left blank. Do NOT confuse with the Producers (A) 'Reclass' box (producers_reclass) — this one belongs to group B.
injdisp_reclass.title: Reclass

injdisp_well_record_only.description: Item 11 > 'B. Injection/Disposal/Storage/Brine Mining' option group: the 'Well record only (explain in remarks)' checkbox. Boolean: true only if this specific box is marked/checked on the scan, false if left blank. Do NOT confuse with the Producers (A) 'Well record only' box (producers_well_record_only).
injdisp_well_record_only.title: Well Record Only Explain In Remarks

spud_date.description: Item 12a: Spud date — the date drilling began. Transcribe the typed/handwritten value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, punctuation and any printed unit); null if the box is blank. Do NOT confuse with item 12b 'Date of first production after rig released' (date_first_production_after_rig_released) or with the item-27 commenced/ended dates.
spud_date.title: 12a Spud Date

date_first_production_after_rig_released.description: Item 12b: Date of first production after rig released. Transcribe the typed/handwritten value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, punctuation and any printed unit); null if the box is blank. Do NOT confuse with Spud date (item 12a) or with the item-27 plug-back/deepening/recompletion/drilling Commenced/Ended dates.
date_first_production_after_rig_released.title: 12b Date Of First Production After Rig Released

item13_recompletion_or_reclass.description: Item 13 option box: 'Recompletion or reclass' checkbox (top-left of the item-13 former-reservoir block). Boolean: true only if this specific box is marked/checked on the scan, false if left blank. Do NOT confuse with item 13 'Multiple completions' (item13_multiple_completions) or with item 23 'Recompletion'/'Reclass'-style boxes.
item13_recompletion_or_reclass.title: Recompletion Or Reclass

item13_multiple_completions.description: Item 13 option box: 'Multiple completion(s)' checkbox. Boolean: true only if this specific box is marked/checked on the scan, false if left blank. Do NOT confuse with item 13 'Recompletion or reclass' (item13_recompletion_or_reclass).
item13_multiple_completions.title: Multiple Completions

item13_field_reservoir.description: Item 13 former-reservoir detail: 'Field & Reservoir' — the former field name (with reservoir) for a recompletion/reclass, or one of the listed reservoirs for a multiple completion. Item 13's instruction: 'If recompletion or reclass, give former field (with reservoir) ... If multiple completion, list all reservoir names'. Transcribe the typed/handwritten value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, punctuation and any printed unit); null if the box is blank. Do NOT confuse with the current Field Name (item 1) or with item13_gas_id_or_oil_lease_no.
item13_field_reservoir.title: Field Reservoir

item13_gas_id_or_oil_lease_no.description: Item 13 former-reservoir detail: 'Gas ID or Oil Lease No.' of the former field/reservoir. Transcribe the typed/handwritten value verbatim as printed (preserve leading zeros, casing, punctuation and any printed unit); null if the box is blank.
